rec.name: Announcement Bar with Slideshow (Trust/Rating Ticker)
rec.status: Built — code archived for reuse (originally from ARDAP PDP test)

what.text: A full-width colored bar at the very top of the page (above the header) that shows up to 5 short message items in a Swiper-based slider. Each item can combine a bold title, 5 rating stars, a content line (e.g. '4.9 ★★★★★ over 10,000 reviews') and an icon (uploaded image or inline SVG) placed left or right. On desktop 1–4 items are visible at once; on mobile one item is shown with prev/next arrows. The bar can be non-sticky or sticky on desktop, mobile or everywhere.

why.text: Placing review ratings and key benefit messages in the first thing the visitor sees delivers social proof and trust immediately, before they scroll. A high-contrast brand-colored bar draws attention without taking much space. The slider lets several messages (reviews, shipping, guarantee) share one slot. A sticky option keeps the trust signal visible while scrolling.

how.text: Create a section 'announcement-bar.liquid' with up to 5 'Item' blocks. The section renders a custom element <ed-announcement-bar> containing a Swiper container; each block becomes a swiper-slide with a list of icon, title, optional 5 stars (rendered via the theme's 'icon' snippet 'rating-star'), and content text. Swiper 11 CSS/JS is loaded lazily from jsDelivr and initialised with slidesPerView 1 on mobile and a configurable number from 768px up. Navigation arrows are shown, and hidden on desktop when all blocks fit in the view. Autoplay setting toggles 'loop'. Sticky behavior is done with CSS position: sticky and CSS variables (--announcement-bar-height, --enable-sticky-announcement-bar) which other header code can use for offsets; height is also measured via JS. Colors are passed as RGB CSS variables. Add the section to the header group in the theme editor.

items: Position: Non sticky / Sticky (Desktop only) / Sticky (Mobile only) / Sticky everywhere
Auto rotate between slides (checkbox, controls loop)
Block: Icon as image or as SVG (HTML)

dependencies.text: Needs a theme with an 'icon' snippet that includes a 'rating-star' icon, and a .container class. Loads Swiper 11 from the jsDelivr CDN (external dependency; consider self-hosting for performance/GDPR). Default texts are German. Uses hard-coded bar heights (33px mobile / 41px desktop) for sticky offset. Original ticket wish-list (arrow color, content size, section paddings, slideshow on mobile/desktop/all) is only partially in the code: arrow color is hard-coded white, padding is hard-coded 7px. Note the 'autoplay' setting only toggles loop and does not enable true autoplay.

items: Bounce rate / engagement on landing page
Click-through to reviews or the next step
Scroll depth and sticky-bar interactions (arrow clicks)

images.caption: Mobile PDP variant: orange announcement bar above the header with prev/next arrows and the text '4.9 ★★★★★ bei über 10.000 Bewertungen' with a rating-badge icon.

Theme editor: Announcement bar in the header group with two Item blocks, desktop preview showing two items side by side, and settings for Position, Auto rotate, Slides per view, Text color and Background.
